nameJa: イタリック・ブロードキャスト
headline: YouTube / Fullscreen / Live Chat
conceptNote: Fullscreenの傾いた字形と、Live Chatの直立した赤文字を対比。小さな画面記号を右下に添え、文字のリズムを主役にする。
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished typographic promotional graphic for a Chrome extension keeping chat inside fullscreen YouTube video. Output a compact landscape 11:7 canvas, target 1760 × 1120 (not an ultrawide panorama), edge-to-edge.
Design direction: refined European broadcast motion typography, beautifully restrained and contemporary. Typography is the main artwork. Warm white, ink black and one clear signal red. Flat print-clean graphic, absolutely no 3D, shadows, physical materials, glow or rendered objects.
Typeface design is crucial: “Fullscreen” uses an elegant confident controlled italic humanist sans, medium weight, clear open counters, graceful forward movement, subtly distinctive terminals, optical kerning. NOT an ultra-condensed font, NOT big chunky generic Arial. “Live Chat” uses perfectly composed upright medium-weight sans, carefully spaced, creating a poised contrast to the italic. “YouTube” uses substantial upright medium sans and is visually important, at least about 80 px cap height on a 1572 px wide output.
Layout: clean white field, YouTube upper-left at a generous 8% inset, italic Fullscreen as the main uninterrupted word across the middle of the composition, upright red Live Chat directly below at left. Controlled directional rhythm comes from the italic letters, never from decorative speed lines. Below and to the right is ONE spare landscape video outline with four precise fullscreen corner marks, and one small red chat shape fully INSIDE its right edge. The diagram is secondary and smaller than the type; one simple play triangle and two plain short lines inside the chat symbol. Keep it separate from the words.
Exact visible text, each group ONCE, spelled and capitalized precisely: “YouTube”, “Fullscreen”, “Live Chat”. No other text. Fullscreen stays ONE word on ONE line. YouTube must be clearly readable at 220 × 140 preview along with both main words. All letters and the diagram stay within an 8% safe inset; ample breathing room, no cropping.
Sophisticated flat art direction, no generic tech template, gamer poster, decorative textures, oversized chunky bold, bevels, glass, paper shadows, photographs, people, dashboards, fake UI, avatars, badges, watermark or numbers.

revisions.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Refine ONLY the typography of this promotional design, preserving its white / ink / red palette, exact words and small bottom-right video-with-chat illustration.
The current letterforms are much too heavy. Make this an elegant typographic identity with TRUE LIGHT / REGULAR strokes. Use weight 300 for “Fullscreen”, with each vertical stem about ONE THIRD of its current thickness. Fullscreen remains a graceful readable italic sans, normal width, one unbroken word, but is delicate, open and refined rather than bold. Do not leave bold lettering.
Set “Live Chat” in an upright normal-width sans, TRUE LIGHT / REGULAR weight 300–400, again strokes about ONE THIRD current thickness. Do not condense it. Give the two main lines generous leading and airy optical spacing.
“YouTube” remains substantial and clearly legible but becomes an upright REGULAR sans, not heavy or condensed; remove the current oversized bold treatment. Preserve the small red play symbol beside this word if desired but do not introduce other graphics.
Layout stays compact landscape 11:7 (1760 × 1120 target, not panorama), with the same hierarchical layout and a secondary black landscape video frame containing a red chat symbol. Keep all words and graphic comfortably inside at least 8% margins, with no letter clipping or overlap. The letter strokes must still remain visible at 220 × 140.
Visible text must remain EXACTLY these three phrases, each ONCE: “YouTube”, “Fullscreen”, “Live Chat”. No other words, numbers, captions or watermark. No 3D, textures, shadows, glass, bevel, glow or new effects. Main change is dramatically LIGHTER refined typography, not a new arrangement of the same bold font.
revisions.reason: Reduce heavy typography to light or regular strokes while preserving exact copy and graphic.

refinementReview: Inspected actual saved PNG. Typography is visibly lighter; all three exact phrases are present once, no clipped letters, chat shape fully inside fullscreen boundary.
